purpose: Review a finite catalog of six residual minute-data mechanisms against the frozen 155-definition library, 142 numerical comparators, original minute-source contract and all terminal operator families before reading any protected value.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_ordinal_time_reversal_js_234t
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Compare the pooled forward and time-reversed distributions of exact weak-order return triples with a normalized Jensen-Shannon divergence.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact weak-order triple alphabet, forward/reverse mapping and Jensen-Shannon normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Return weak-order entropy, return time-reversal asymmetry, range weak-order time-reversal divergence and return-direction phrases are complete terminal definitions. Applying the already exposed reversal-divergence operator to the exposed return weak-order stream is an operator transfer, not a new observed state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_amount_weak_order_time_reversal_js_236t
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Compare forward and time-reversed exact weak-order triple distributions of the 240-bar amount path with a normalized Jensen-Shannon divergence.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: exact amount weak-order alphabet, half-session boundary and Jensen-Shannon normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Amount weak-order entropy, amount timing, amount runs and the already exposed weak-order reversal-divergence operator consume the same order path. Moving that operator to amount after those results creates a field/operator sibling search.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_multifractal_spectrum_width_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Estimate a within-session multifractal spectrum width from fixed-scale detrended fluctuation functions of absolute and signed minute returns.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed scale grid, detrending order, moment grid and spectrum-width fit
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Diffusive variation, five-minute variance ratio, spectral entropy, chord adherence, realized variance and jump variation already cover multiscale return roughness. A multifractal fit adds discretionary scales, moments and regression without a contract-distinct information state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_return_energy_distance_119p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Compute an energy distance between the empirical signed-return distributions of the fixed morning and afternoon half sessions.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: one empirical energy-distance functional over two fixed 119-return samples
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Morning-afternoon return profile persistence, volatility resolution, return entropy, skewness and half-session shock reversal already expose changes in signed-return shape and scale. Energy distance is an alternate distributional summary of those same two samples.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_transaction_price_tail_l_moment_ratio_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Use volume-weighted transaction-price log observations to estimate a proposed upper-versus-lower tail L-moment ratio over the full session.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed weighted L-moment order and signed tail-ratio normalization
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Volume-weighted transaction-price consensus, Bowley skewness and half-session dispersion resolution are terminal and explicitly freeze alternate centers, quantiles and distribution summaries. L-moments only reopen that exposed estimator family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_peer_return_network_centrality_238m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Build a same-session stock-return similarity graph and score the candidate stock's centrality in the market network.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: proposed similarity estimator, graph threshold or kernel and centrality definition
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Market idiosyncratic share, response delay, sign agreement, magnitude decoupling, dispersion decoupling and market profile synchronization already consume same-session peer-return dependence. Graph construction adds threshold, kernel and centrality selection to the same exposed relation.

selection.reason: Every residual proposal transfers an exposed operator to an exposed minute path or replaces an estimator inside terminal roughness, half-session distribution, transaction-price or market-dependence families.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Continue only from a genuinely new finite prevalue mechanism or a separately accepted historically versioned point-in-time source whose original collection contract permits the proposed use.
